checks.name: exact-empty-input
canonical-path-denial
checks.run:
from mission_control.drive_http import route
from mission_control.common import Invalid
from types import SimpleNamespace
p=['api','apps','synthetic','drive']
route(SimpleNamespace(path='/api/apps/synthetic/drive'),p)
try:route(SimpleNamespace(path='/api/apps/synthetic/drive?foreign=1'),p)
except Invalid:pass
else:raise AssertionError('Noncanonical path must be denied')
